description: CLPFUDatabase is an R metapackage for a suite that builds comparable societal energy-conversion-chain data. Its own repository brings together packages for primary energy, final energy, useful work and related matrix operations, while the JOSS paper repository lists the component projects. Users choose countries, source releases and years, so coverage and time span follow external energy statistics, not data bundled with the metapackage. The own DESCRIPTION states MIT plus a licence file. The resulting chain tables can help compare fuel, electricity and useful-energy assumptions in national energy-system scenarios. A caveat is that upstream data rights and conversions remain separate, and installing a metapackage does not verify the quality of every component or source statistic. The JOSS-linked GitHub repository contains the paper, not the metapackage; this draft points to the latter. No catalogue or first-review software record matched it. No IEA or other large datasets were downloaded.
name: CLPFUDatabase energy-chain metapackage
notes: G5 G5-0725. Software checked through metadata and documentation, without installation or execution. Geographic scope follows the documented application or software portability; it does not imply validation throughout that area.
